Divergent DBs — live: 0 channels / 0 gates / 50 experiments / 0 ledger / €0; repo legacy: 10 channels / 16 gates / 68 experiments / 11 ledger / 5 with sales / €38
Acceptance criterion 1 unachievable as configured — reachability ≠ connectivity; no domain, no credentials, no client

Browser automation was reported deterministically broken (os error 4551) on 2026-09-20; on this run the repo Playwright stack rendered 3 live Shopify surfaces without error, so storefront inspection is no longer tooling-blocked — it is blocked solely by the missing store target
Evidence hazard: the live DB carries a multi-MB pending WAL; only db + -wal + -shm co-copied reproduces live state (this run copied all three and verified sha256 equality of the main file)
Catalog keeps growing with no consumer: 50 APPROVED experiments in the live DB, 0 assigned to any channel, 0 with sales, €0 verified revenue, while digital_products/ holds 19 build artifacts (7 xlsx)
